description: List proposals owned by this key's account, newest first, with status counts. Defaults to pending; expired proposals are reported as expired after the server sweeps stale pending rows. Approved means the owner authorized the change (not that it was executed); applied means the owner marked the authorized change as executed; rejected proposals carry the owner's decision note. Requires the audit:read scope and a key owned by an account.
name: list_proposals
title: Read proposals and their decisions
